answer: 近几十年来，科学逐渐形成了一种惯例：人们只能通过大学之类的机构来参与科学研究。
但是，只要借助公众天生的好奇心，让非科学人士直接参与到研究过程中来，就有可能克服其中的许多挑战。
科学家们采用了多种方式吸引公众参与他们的研究，比如把数据分析做成网络游戏，或者把样本采集做成智能手机应用程序。
这些人属于一场迅速壮大的生物技术社会运动，参与其中的公民科学家和专业科学家力图让科学发现走出研究机构，交到每一个怀有热情的人手中。
他们整合资源、通力合作、跳出思维定式，寻找解决问题和绕开障碍的办法，为科学本身而探索科学，不受在正规机构内工作的传统界限束缚。

Dear Paul,

Thanks for your interest in the craft show, which will be held in the Student Center next Friday afternoon. Six young craftsmen will show how traditional skills can be combined with new ideas. For example, one of them makes paper-cuts with laser tools, and another designs bamboo lamps that can be controlled by a smartphone. Visitors will also have a chance to make simple items themselves.

As for your kind offer, I would be grateful if you could help design the posters and invite international students to come. Besides, we need someone to take photos during the show. Could we meet on Wednesday to discuss the details?

Best wishes,
Li Ming

The table shows how many air conditioners, washing machines and refrigerators every 100 Chinese households owned at the end of 2014, 2017, 2020 and 2023. Over these ten years, the number of air conditioners nearly doubled, rising from 75.2 to 145.9, while washing machines and refrigerators increased steadily from about 84 and 86 to roughly 98 and 103 respectively.

These figures reflect the remarkable rise in Chinese people's living standards. To begin with, sustained economic growth has raised household incomes, so families can now afford appliances that were once regarded as luxuries. In addition, policies such as subsidies for home appliances in rural areas have made these products more accessible. The sharp increase in air conditioners, in particular, shows that people are no longer satisfied with basic needs but are pursuing a more comfortable life.

In my view, this trend is encouraging, but it also reminds us to consume responsibly. Manufacturers should develop energy-saving products, and consumers should recycle old appliances properly. Only in this way can a better life go hand in hand with a greener environment.
它们有时会跋涉六十多英里去寻找食物或水源，而且非常善于判断其他大象身在何处——即使那些大象不在视线范围之内。
研究人员确信，大象始终清楚地知道自己相对于所需各种资源的确切位置，因此除了沿着熟悉的路线行走之外，它们还能抄近路。
一种可能是，大象只是用眼睛寻找，再尝一尝发现的植物，但这样很可能会浪费大量时间和精力，尤其是因为它们的视力其实并不好。
植物释放的挥发性化学物质能够传播到很远的地方，而且特征十分鲜明：每一种植物或树木都有自己独特的气味标识。
实验表明，大象很可能是利用嗅觉，首先找出值得采食的树丛，其次判断每片树丛中树木的好坏。

Dear Paul,

I am glad to help with your oral report. Here are some suggestions.

First, choose a scientist whose story is both inspiring and easy to explain, such as Zhang Heng, who invented an instrument to detect earthquakes. Second, collect reliable information from the library and academic websites, and focus on his major achievements and their influence today. Third, make some slides with pictures or models, which will make your report vivid and help your classmates follow you. Finally, rehearse several times and keep within the time limit.

If you need any books, I can lend you mine. Good luck with your report!

Yours,
Li Ming

The picture shows residents enjoying a newly built park right outside their homes: a couple are strolling hand in hand, some people are jogging, and a young man exclaims, "What a nice little park at our doorstep!" The chart beside it indicates that the number of parks in a certain city rose from 406 in 2020 to 532 in 2021, and further to 670 in 2022.

The two images reveal that more and more small parks are being built close to where people live, which brings considerable benefits. On the one hand, they offer convenient places for exercise and relaxation, helping citizens stay physically and mentally healthy. On the other hand, they serve as public spaces where neighbors can meet and talk, which strengthens community ties. Moreover, the green space beautifies the city and improves the environment.

In my opinion, this trend is a vivid example of people-oriented urban development. The government should continue to plan parks in densely populated areas and keep them well maintained, while residents should take good care of public facilities. Only when everyone contributes can our cities become more livable.
人工智能还可以用来识别客户在兴趣爱好、喜爱的名人和时尚等方面的生活方式选择，从而在通过社交媒体发布的营销信息中提供独特的内容。
有些人认为，人工智能会削弱创造力、减少工作岗位，从而对营销人员的作用产生负面影响；但他们也意识到，人工智能是降低成本、创造新信息的一种手段。
用于模拟人际互动的算法正在引发许多此类担忧，尤其是因为没有人能确切知道，用人工智能与客户互动会产生怎样的结果。
如果客户不愿意分享数据，人工智能就会缺少必需的信息，既无法有效运行，也无法利用机器学习来改进其营销内容和沟通方式。
以顾及目标客户需求的方式、在不打扰客户的前提下传递营销信息，是数字营销人员面临的关键挑战之一。

In the picture, crowds of villagers line the riverbank and the bridge, cheering loudly as several dragon boats race forward. Watching the exciting scene, an elderly couple smile happily, and the woman says, "How wonderful! The dragon boat race in our village is getting more and more lively!"

The picture vividly shows that traditional festivals and folk activities are flourishing in China's countryside. This revival is significant in several ways. First, it enriches villagers' cultural life and brings people together, strengthening the bonds within the community. Second, such events help pass on traditional culture to younger generations, so that customs like dragon boat racing will not fade away. Third, they attract tourists and promote local economies, contributing to rural revitalization.

In my view, we should spare no effort to support this trend. Local governments can invest in facilities and organize cultural events, while young people should take an active part in them instead of regarding them as old-fashioned. Only when traditions are truly alive in daily life can our culture remain vigorous.
这还是一场编码者与破译者之间的较量——而这一点，就连许多熟知这段历史的人也不知道。
附录列出了许多从驻西班牙法军手中缴获的密码文件，破解这些文件秘密的，是英军司令部一位名叫乔治·斯科维尔的军官。
他无法细致分析这位名不见经传的军官究竟对那场国与国之间的大战有没有贡献、有何贡献，也确实没能告诉我们多少有关此人本身的情况。
拿破仑战争期间或许有过许多间谍和情报官员，但要找到他们实际提供或经手处理过的材料，通常却极其困难。
正如破译密码在争夺西班牙的斗争中具有更广泛的意义，他为在晋升阶梯上步步攀升所作的种种努力，也深刻反映了英国社会的状况。

As shown in the picture, two female students are standing in front of a bulletin board on which a campus lecture is announced. One of them says, "It has nothing to do with our major, so it is useless to attend." The other, however, believes that listening to it will surely do them good.

The contrast between the two girls reflects two attitudes toward learning. The first girl holds a narrow view, valuing only knowledge directly related to her major. The second girl, by contrast, is open-minded and eager to broaden her horizons. In today's world, many problems are solved by combining ideas from different fields, and employers increasingly value people with wide knowledge. A lecture outside one's major may spark new ideas, sharpen critical thinking and even reveal new interests.

Therefore, I side with the second girl. As college students, we should not limit ourselves to the textbooks of our own major. Instead, we should make good use of lectures and other resources on campus to enrich ourselves. After all, the more widely we learn, the better prepared we will be for the future.
战争结束时，这些社会的高等教育入学人数约占相应年龄人口的3%～5%，这一比例在战前几十年间基本保持不变。
而且，这些社会中接受高等教育的需求不断上升，并扩展到了战前从未想过上大学的群体和社会阶层。
在西欧许多国家，高校学生人数在20世纪60年代每五年就翻一番，到70年代中期，又在七年、八年或十年内再次翻番。
当新进教员大多是刚完成研究生学业的年轻人时，他们在很大程度上决定了该院系学术生活的规范。
高增长率增加了学术创新的机会，同时也削弱了那些在稳定或缓慢增长时期让教师和学生得以进入学者共同体的形式和程序。

Dear Tom,

Congratulations on your graduation! I am glad to hear that you plan to work in China, and here are some suggestions.

First, think carefully about what kind of job suits you. With your language advantage, you may consider positions in foreign trade, education or international companies. Second, search for openings on popular recruitment websites and attend job fairs in big cities, where many employers look for international talent. Third, learn some basic Chinese and get to know Chinese working culture, which will help you adapt quickly. Finally, make sure your work visa is in order.

I hope you will find an ideal job soon.

Yours,
Li Ming

In the picture, a little boy dressed as the Monkey King tells his father that many of his classmates find learning Chinese opera boring. With a gentle smile, the father replies, "Don't you like it yourself? That's enough."

The picture conveys a simple but important message: we should follow our genuine interests instead of being swayed by others' opinions. Interest is the best teacher. When we truly love something, we are willing to devote time and energy to it, and we can enjoy the process even when it is hard. If we give up what we like simply because others do not appreciate it, we may lose both a source of happiness and a chance to develop our potential. Moreover, the father's response shows the value of parental support, which gives children the confidence to stick to their choices.

In my view, it is natural that people have different tastes, and we should respect our own choices as well as others'. As students, we should listen to useful advice, but we must also have the courage to pursue what we love. Only then can we live a fulfilling life.
随着教会的教义和思维方式在文艺复兴面前黯然失色，中世纪与近代之间的鸿沟得以弥合，从而开辟出崭新的、未经探索的思想领域。
在他们各自提出这些发现之前，当时许多思想家一直坚持更为古老的思维方式，其中就包括认为地球位于宇宙中心的地心说。
尽管教会试图压制这一代新的逻辑学家和理性主义者，但关于宇宙如何运行的解释仍在不断涌现，其速度之快，已让人们无法再视而不见。
随着许多人肩负起将理性思维和科学哲学融入世界的使命，文艺复兴宣告结束，一个新的时代——理性时代——到来了。
这种探求知识、理解已知信息的行为，可以用拉丁语短语“sapere aude”，即“敢于求知”来概括。

The two cartoons, entitled "Habits", present a sharp contrast. On the left, a girl is working hard at her desk, saying, "Only when I finish early can I feel at ease." On the right, a boy is lying back in his chair with his book left aside, declaring, "I won't start until the last minute."

The cartoons remind us that good habits, especially avoiding procrastination, play a vital role in our study and work. Finishing tasks early leaves us enough time to check our work and deal with unexpected problems, so we can complete things with high quality and a peaceful mind. By contrast, putting things off until the deadline often leads to stress, careless mistakes and even failure. Over time, such a habit may also damage our reputation and self-confidence.

In my opinion, it is worthwhile for everyone to develop the habit of acting promptly. We can start by making a reasonable plan, breaking large tasks into small steps and setting our own deadlines. As the saying goes, never put off till tomorrow what can be done today.
